title: Model Library: a model reads partial forever when its leftover files belong to a plugin, a Flow or the engine
description: Found on MPI-1057, split out of MPI-1076 (2026-10-11, Fabio live on a Pod volume): Wan 2.2 Smooth 20%, Wan 2.2 5B 36%, Krea 2 (+NSFW) 20% show as partly downloaded, and Uninstall removes nothing on every click. The files are umt5_xxl + wan_2.1_vae (required by the scene-path plugin, MPI-623) and qwen3vl-abliterated-clip (universal; minimax-music Flow). Uninstall rightly keeps them. Root: _computePartial (MpiModelManager.js) excludes only deps held by an INSTALLED other model (_sharedOwnedDepIds), not deps held by an installed plugin, Flow or the engine, so those files count as this model's own progress. The backend already knows the holders (_localSharedDepsMap adds (plugin)/(flow) in routes/downloadManager.js); the Library's partial test needs the same set. MPI-1076 already stopped the uninstall toast saying uninstalled on removed 0.
